verdict.rationale: A probe confirms developer.nvidia.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a descriptive summary of NVIDIA's developer portal, showing agent-oriented docs discovery is possible. However, this is for the general NVIDIA Developer ecosystem rather than RTX 5080-specific docs, and related agent-friendly formats (markdown docs, OpenAPI spec) return 404s. Missing for 10: RTX 5080-specific llms.txt/agent docs, working markdown doc mirrors, and an accessible OpenAPI/machine-readable spec.
